_comment: Registry of every e2e spec. verify.mjs reads it to deploy the right version(s) and check each spec. kind: 'regression' = red on brokenVersion, green on latest; fixedVersion records the release known to contain the fix. 'open' = still red on brokenVersion, no fix yet (fixedVersion null); 'smoke' = green on `version` ('latest' resolves to the newest release). The reproduction array documents the manual steps the spec automates.

1058.title: Baserow duration format is preserved in the data grid
1058.rootCause: Originally reported in 2.1.0-beta112, whose release asset cannot be deployed by the current runner. The executable broken target is 2.2.0-beta218, the last 2.2 tag before the fix. Baserow Duration fields store raw seconds but expose a formatted display value according to duration_format, such as h:mm:ss. The C8oForms Grid bean previously rendered raw seconds (5025 / 15) instead of Baserow formatted values (1:23:45 / 0:00:15). Fix 2d04fde4 (first in 2.2.0-beta220, OK in 2.2.0-beta223) made the grid consume the formatted display value path shared with the Baserow date-format fix.
reproduction: Ensure the Baserow fixture C8oForms E2E -> Regression Fixtures -> Issue 1058 Duration Formats exists with a Duration h:mm:ss column configured as duration_format h:mm:ss.
Seed rows row_1058_long = 5025 seconds and row_1058_short = 15 seconds.
Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Data Grid component and rename it baserow_duration_grid_1058.
Configure the Data Grid from the Baserow source Issue 1058 Duration Formats through the component source configuration UI.
Open the viewer and observe that the Duration cells display 1:23:45 and 0:00:15 instead of raw seconds 5025 and 15.

1086.title: Radio Group and Checkbox Group apply visual, text and JavaScript default values
1086.rootCause: The Radio Group and Checkbox Group default-value work reused the shared DefaultValueEditorWithPalette flow from #1109, with group-specific object formats for rows and options. Follow-up eabc197f (first in 2.2.0-beta233) fixed the editor header/card configured-default indicator so Aa/text-mode group defaults are detected and shown; before that, text-mode group defaults could be configured but the component card missed the default-value indicator.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.

Add three Radio Group components and three Checkbox Group components; rename them radio_group_visual_1086/radio_group_text_1086/radio_group_js_1086 and checkbox_group_visual_1086/checkbox_group_text_1086/checkbox_group_js_1086.
Use the default group rows Line 1, Line 2, Line 3 and options Option 1, Option 2.
Configure Default Value in the three modes for each group component: visual matrix mode, Aa text mode with the expected JSON object format, and JS mode while preserving the generated async wrapper.
For every configured Radio Group and Checkbox Group component, observe that the editor component card shows the configured default-value indicator.
Open the viewer and observe that every Radio Group and Checkbox Group row is initialized with the configured default values.

1109.title: Select, Radio and Checkbox apply visual, text and JavaScript default values
1109.rootCause: Before #1109, the simple choice components did not consistently expose the shared sourceable Default Value editor nor compute those defaults in the viewer. Fix 9edfcbe4 added the DefaultValueEditorWithPalette flow and viewer default computation for Select, Radio, and Checkbox; follow-ups ef75244e and ffee8cfe added the header/default-value affordances and expected-format help for Aa/JS modes.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.

Add three Select components, three Radio components and three Checkbox components; rename them select_visual_1109/select_text_1109/select_js_1109, radio_visual_1109/radio_text_1109/radio_js_1109 and checkbox_visual_1109/checkbox_text_1109/checkbox_js_1109.
For every component, configure local options Alpha, Beta and Gamma through the component Configuration -> Source configuration UI.
Configure Default Value in the three modes for each component: visual mode, Aa text mode, and JS mode while preserving the generated async wrapper.
Open the viewer and observe that the Select, Radio and Checkbox components are initialized with the values configured in each mode.

1327.title: Condition action switches between Aa and JavaScript modes
1327.rootCause: In 2.2.0-beta127, the Condition (if) flow action displayed field/operator, Aa, and JS mode buttons, but clicking Aa or JS did not switch the editor mode. The current editor must allow switching between field/operator, Aa/text, and JavaScript/Monaco modes.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Button component and rename it condition_button_1327.
Open the Button workflow from the Workflows panel.
Add the Condition action from the action palette.
Open the Condition action configuration and observe the If editor.
Click Aa mode and observe that the text editor becomes visible.
Click JS mode and observe that the JavaScript Monaco editor becomes visible.
Click Aa mode and observe that the text editor becomes visible again.
Click field/operator mode and observe that the condition builder becomes visible again.

1329.title: Loop action exposes Aa and JavaScript iterator configuration
1329.rootCause: The Loop flow action rendered its editor shell in 2.2.0-beta127, but the iterator section was empty because the DefaultValueEditorWithPalette was missing from the for_loop configuration row. The current UI intentionally exposes a single Loop section with Aa/text and JavaScript modes to define the iterator.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Button component and rename it loop_button_1329.
Open the Button workflow from the Workflows panel.
Add the Loop action from the action palette.
Open the Loop action configuration and observe that the Loop iterator editor is visible.
Configure the iterator in Aa/text mode, then switch to JavaScript mode and observe that the generated JS editor is available.

1334.title: If condition workflow fields show an operator selector
1334.rootCause: conditionVisibleIf.getType() returned an empty string for field references whose type was not explicitly listed, such as the Condition workflow action type if_else. No operator ion-select matched that empty type, so the If action showed an empty operator slot after selecting a flow action. Fix 95424cfc (first in 2.2.0-beta137, validated OK in 2.2.0-beta144) treats unknown types as simple fields.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Button component and rename it button_1334.
Open the Button workflow from the Workflows panel.
Add the Condition action from the action palette.
Open the Condition action configuration and use the If field picker to select the generated Condition workflow action id if_else1.
Observe that beta135 shows no operator selector for if_else1, while the fixed version renders the simple-field operator selector.

1335.title: Condition action configuration does not expose empty Then/Else tabs
1335.rootCause: The Condition flow action configuration listed If, Then, and Else in flowConditionMainEditorConfigurationTabs. Then/Else were empty in that configuration side panel and could not accept actions there; branch actions are configured from the workflow canvas instead. Fix 706855ff (first in 2.2.0-beta136, validated OK in 2.2.0-beta143) removes Then/Else from the configuration tabs, leaving only If.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Button component and rename it button_1335.
Open the Button workflow from the Workflows panel.
Add the Condition action from the action palette.
Open the Condition action configuration panel.
Observe that beta135 exposes three configuration tabs (If, Then, Else), where Then/Else are empty; the fixed version exposes only the If configuration tab.

1353.title: Sort reports a missing data source instead of loading forever
1353.rootCause: The Sort section of dataSourceEditor fell into its loading fallback when forms_config/table configuration was missing, leaving an indeterminate ion-progress-bar visible forever. Fix a804c4d5 added the missing-configuration error paragraph for that fallback path and disabled the progress bar; the fix first appeared in 2.2.0-beta150 and was validated OK in 2.2.0-beta153.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Data Grid component to the page through the component palette.
Open the Data Grid configuration panel, choose From a data source, and select the lib_BaseRow getData source type.
Do not configure a Baserow table.
Open Configuration de la source, then open the Sort/Tri section.
Observe that beta147 shows an endless indeterminate progress bar instead of the missing data-source configuration message.

1354.title: Button style panel exposes only button-specific sections
1354.rootCause: buttonMainEditorStyleTabs still included the shared tab_selector_grid_question entry and selected it by default, so the Button style configuration exposed the irrelevant generic Question section before button_style and button_icon. Fix d50b64c6 removed that shared question tab and made button_style the default; the fix first appeared in 2.2.0-beta151 and was validated OK in 2.2.0-beta153.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Button component to the page through the component palette.
Open the Button component configuration panel.

Observe the style tab group: beta150 shows three sections including the generic Question section, while the fixed version shows only the two button-specific sections for button style and button icon configuration.

1355.title: Button style tabs are translated outside French
1355.rootCause: buttonMainEditorStyleTabs used French labels directly for button_style and button_icon, so non-French Studio languages still displayed Style du bouton and Icône du bouton. Fix 871a529c changes the tab labels to the button_style/button_icon i18n keys and adds translations to en/es/fr/it; the fix first shipped in 2.2.0-beta151 and was validated OK in 2.2.0-beta153.
reproduction: Open Studio in English.
Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Button component to the page through the component palette.
Open the Button component configuration panel.
Observe the Button style tabs.
On beta150 the Button style tabs still display the French hardcoded labels; the fixed version displays Button style and Button icon.

1356.title: Button icon can be cleared for a text-only button
1356.rootCause: The Button Icon editor only allowed replacing the current icon, leaving no way to remove it and create a text-only Button. Fix 0ef67c13 adds a close-outline clear control that calls setButtonConfig("icon", "") and hides the Button viewer icon when the icon value is empty; the fix first shipped in 2.2.0-beta151 and was validated OK in 2.2.0-beta153.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Button component to the page through the component palette.
Open the Button component configuration panel.
Open the Button Icon style section.
Try to remove the selected icon so the Button is text-only.
On beta150 there is no clear control and the Button is forced to keep an icon; the fixed version exposes a clear control and removes the rendered icon.

1365.title: New Button components default to an available bulb icon
1365.rootCause: New Button creation initialized config.icon to bulb-outline, but that icon name is absent from the icon picker/list. Fix b0605dbf changes the default to bulb, which is available; the ticket was validated OK in 2.2.0-beta155. Existing old buttons with bulb-outline are intentionally not migrated.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Button component to the page through the component palette.
Open the Button component configuration panel.
Open the Button Icon style section.
Observe that beta150 initializes the icon name to bulb-outline, while the fixed version initializes it to the available bulb icon.

1357.title: Source completion element lists are sorted, searchable, and visibly scrollable
1357.rootCause: The source-completion popover used by component configuration/visibility lists rendered candidates in source order and without a searchable, bounded scroll UI. Fix f7eb45b3 added sorted/filterable PopOverSourceCompletion rendering with scroll affordances; follow-up af7add77 adjusted the search icon/input layout.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form.
Add enough Text input components to make the Elements list longer than the popover viewport, and rename their technical identifiers in deliberately unsorted order.
Add Button, Select, and Data Grid components, rename their technical identifiers, and open each component configuration panel.
For each target component, open Configuration -> Visibility, switch to condition-based visibility, add a condition, and open the Elements picker.

Observe that the picker exposes a search bar, renders the component type images, sorts the text inputs alphabetically, filters immediately when typing a technical identifier, and shows a bounded scrollable list.

1363.title: Deleting a component inside an Horizontal layout also deletes the layout itself
1363.rootCause: The editor's delete (delElementIndex / closeOptions) removed the whole container instead of the selected child. Fix 1f58b05dd (plus follow-up fdabd9bd1) resolves the actually-selected child (getSelectedChildEditorItem / parentRef) and removes only it, leaving the layout and its other children. The layout-child UI was later refactored: on the fixed line each child has its own editor with a dedicated Supprimer; on the old buggy line the child is deleted from its config panel whose trash was wrongly bound to the parent.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form; open it in the editor.
Add a Horizontal layout (palette tile 'Disposition horizontale').
Drag a Text input and a Description from the palette into the layout (real drag-and-drop; layouts only accept children by drag, not double-click).
Delete one of the two nested children (open the child's editor and click Supprimer, or on the old UI select the child and use its trash) and confirm.
On beta151 the entire Horizontal layout (and both children) is removed; the fix removes only the selected child and keeps the layout plus the other child.

1368.title: Application search results preserve spaces and punctuation in names
1368.rootCause: Selector search results built boldName by replacing matches inside the raw application name and rendered the highlighted HTML with nowrap/flex title styles. When a fragment such as FOLDER was highlighted inside "NOT A FOLDER !", the rendered title visually collapsed spaces around the highlighted fragment and punctuation. Fix 55f447eb preserves escaped text segments while building highlighted HTML and renders selector titles with white-space: pre.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form whose name contains spaces and punctuation, for example NOT A FOLDER !.
Return to the applications selector page.
Use the Applications search field to search for a fragment of the name, for example FOLDER, so the result title is partially highlighted.
Observe the rendered title in the search results.
On beta153 the result is displayed as NOT AFOLDER!; on beta156 and later the result keeps the exact application name with spaces and punctuation.

1370.title: Toast message text drops insert a field chip instead of true
1370.rootCause: Text Source Palette drags used the HTML5 drag type "text" as a marker with value "true". Browsers normalize that key to text/plain, so TinyMCE text-mode Toast messages could insert the literal true instead of the field badge when normal text was already present. Fix c9ae8c51 clears stale drag data and writes the marker under c8oforms-type-text instead; the commit first shipped in 2.2.0-beta161 and the ticket was validated OK in 2.2.0-beta163.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Text input component and rename it input_text_1370.
Add a Button component and rename it button_1370.
Open the Button workflow and add a Toast action from the action palette.
Open the Toast action Message tab and type normal text in the Aa/text editor.
Drag input_text_1370 from the Source Palette Form section into the Toast message.

On beta158 the drag payload exposes text/plain = true, allowing TinyMCE to insert the literal true instead of the field badge; the fixed version exposes c8oforms-type-text and inserts the field token.

1374.title: Application settings opens from an active workflow
1374.rootCause: The application settings cog did not mark that the settings panel was opened from Workflows. After a workflow section or flow was displayed, the workflow branch stayed selected and the settings categories were never rendered. Fix ebc18786 adds the isPanelSettingsOrigin local flag plus a dedicated settings branch for that origin; it first shipped in 2.2.0-beta163 and was validated OK in 2.2.0-beta167.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Open the Workflows panel.
Observe that the Workflows formulas section is displayed.
Click the Application settings cog in the editor sidebar.
On beta158 the cog animates but the application settings panel does not open; the fixed version displays the application settings categories.

1375.title: Application settings keeps the editor sidebar navigation usable
1375.rootCause: The application settings sidebar button reused the palette display toggle path and could set local.hide/isPaletteDisplay so the vertical navigation buttons disappeared while settings were open. The #1375 fix series separates the application-settings origin/panel display from palette visibility, keeping Pages/Workflows/Palette available; the ticket was validated OK in 2.2.0-beta204.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Click the Application settings cog button in the editor sidebar.
Observe that the application settings panel opens.
Observe that the Application settings, Palette, Pages and Workflows sidebar buttons remain visible.
Click Pages directly from the open settings panel and observe that the Pages panel opens.
Click Workflows directly from Pages and observe that the Workflows panel opens.

1382.title: Chart height toggles between Automatic and Personalized modes
1382.rootCause: Current-behavior coverage for #1382. The old beta169 UI exposed only a numeric Chart height field while telling users to type auto, so the historical red is not useful for the modern interface. Fix e0cb72ac introduced a Chart height ToggleSwitch with auto/personalized modes: automatic hides the numeric field, while personalized restores an editable numeric height.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Chart component and open its Data & Interactions configuration.
Observe that the Chart height setting exposes Automatic and Personalized modes.
Select Personalized and observe that the numeric height field appears and accepts a custom value.
Select Automatic and observe that the numeric height field is hidden.
Select Personalized again and verify that the numeric height field remains editable.

1383.title: Renaming a page shows 'name already exists' when the field is left empty
1383.rootCause: The page-name validation raised the nameAlreadyexits message for any rejected value, including an empty one. Fix 269e0386e special-cases an empty/whitespace value to raise the dedicated emptyField message instead. The only observable change is the toast text (the Close button is not disabled), so the test asserts on the validation toast message.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form (it already has one page named 'Page 1').
Open the form in the editor; accept the GDPR notice if shown.
Open the page settings (via the page buttons block or the Pages panel pencil) on the General section.
Clear the 'Nom de la page' field and commit (blur).
Observe the validation toast: beta158 shows 'Ce nom existe déjà...' (nameAlreadyexits) instead of the empty-field message 'Ce champ ne peut être vide' (emptyField).

1389.title: Long page names keep the delete action visible in the Pages panel
1389.rootCause: The Pages panel row allowed a long page label to consume the available row width, so the hover actions could be pushed out of view or overlapped. Fix ba12b3ea refactored the pages/workflows panel layout; the ticket was validated OK in 2.2.0-beta186.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Rename the current page with a very long name.
Open the Pages panel.
Hover the page row.
Observe that the delete action remains visible and inside the page row.

1392.title: Clicking the Page buttons configuration redirects to General instead of Navigation
1392.rootCause: The click handler on the page navigation buttons block left page.local.currentPageSettingsPanel on 'general'; fix 542344019 (fix(actionsButtons)) sets it to 'navigation'. The active page-settings section is reflected by the app-settings-btn-active class on the General/Navigation toggles.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form (it already has one page with the navigation buttons block).
Open the form in the editor; accept the GDPR notice if shown.
Click the page buttons block (the bottom bar holding the Submit/next/prev buttons).
Observe that the page settings open on the General section instead of Navigation (the General toggle is active).

1394.title: Source palette should offer a collapse all option
1394.rootCause: The Source palette only stored per-section expansion state and had no global action to collapse every expanded section. The fix added a list-collapse button plus shared local collapse/onClickCollapse state so one click can close all visible sections without breaking later manual toggles.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form.
Add a Description component and open its configuration panel.
Observe the Source palette next to the rich text editor: several sections are expanded.
Click the Source palette collapse-all button.
All visible Source palette sections collapse.
Click one section header twice; it expands and collapses normally after the global action.

1395.title: Dynamic fields[id] default values resolve to the target field value
1395.rootCause: The expression/runtime support first preserved dynamic fields[id] access in Monaco, then fixed runtime resolution so fields[id] returns the same value as fields["select1"] for simple constant ids. Fix 3767dcf7 first shipped in 2.2.0-beta204, where the ticket was validated OK.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Text input component, rename it select1, and set its default value to Alpha.
Add a second Text input component and rename it dynamic_default_1395.
Open the second component's Default Value JavaScript editor.
Inside the existing async wrapper, write const id = "select1"; return fields[id];.
Open the preview and observe that both Text inputs display Alpha.

1396.title: Checkbox Add Row stores Baserow multiple select values
1396.rootCause: The Baserow forms_AddRow/forms_AddRowFromData sequences received Checkbox values for a multiple_select column but did not normalize text/object/id values to the Baserow option-id payload format, so the row was created while the multi-select cell stayed empty. c8oprj-lib-baserow commit 134391077d33c4f0305d216e162963d8a800df40 added normalizeMultipleSelectValue and applied it to multiple_select fields.
reproduction: Ensure the Baserow fixture C8oForms E2E -> Regression Fixtures -> Issue 1396 Checkbox Multiple Select exists with a Name text column and a Tags multiple_select column containing Alpha, Beta and Gamma.
Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Text input and rename it row_name_1396.
Add a simple Checkbox component, rename it tags_1396, and configure local options Alpha, Beta and Gamma.

Add a Button, rename it submit_1396, open its default flow, add the no-code database Add Row action, select the Baserow table, and map Name from row_name_1396 and Tags from tags_1396 through the Source Palette.
Open the viewer, type a unique row name, select Alpha and Gamma, then click the button.
Observe that the new Baserow row contains the text value in Name and the selected Checkbox values Alpha/Gamma in the Tags multiple_select column; beta190 creates the row but leaves Tags empty.

1399.title: Viewer expressions using api.* resolve in JavaScript defaults and Source Palette drops
1399.rootCause: viewerPage computeVariable shadowed the viewer API with page.api || {}, so api.user.* expressions evaluated against an empty object even though window["api"] was initialized. Fix 68e69971 falls back to window["api"].
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Text input and set its default value to JavaScript, keeping the generated async wrapper and returning api.user.email.
Add a second Text input and, in text mode, drag the User/email Source Palette entry into the default value editor.
Add a Description component and drag the same User/email Source Palette entry into TinyMCE.
Open the viewer: on beta204 the api.user.email defaults and description do not resolve; on the fixed version all three places render the test user's email.

1401.title: Source Select reopens with only the identifier column selected
1401.rootCause: Point 2 only. DisplayTableColumns used indexOf() on page.local.valueColumn even when a Select stored it as a scalar string. A configured value column named identifier therefore also matched the generated id column when reopening the Baserow source configuration. Fix 4367d4c9 (first in 2.2.0-beta218, OK in 2.2.0-beta223) treats scalar valueColumn with exact equality instead of substring matching.
reproduction: Ensure the Baserow fixture C8oForms E2E -> Regression Fixtures -> Issue 1401 Select Identifier exists with Name and identifier text columns and controlled rows.
Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Select component and rename it select_identifier_1401.
Configure the Select as From a data source and select the Baserow table Issue 1401 Select Identifier through the component source configuration UI.
Choose Name as the display column and identifier as the value column, then close the component configuration.
Return home, reopen the same form, reopen the Select source configuration and observe that only identifier is checked in the value column; beta204 wrongly checks id as well.

1402.title: Source Select dropdown has no large blank zone after the last item
1402.rootCause: The source-backed searchable Select used a CDK virtual-scroll item size of 48 while rendered source rows are about 42px high. The accumulated size mismatch left a large blank spacer below the last option. Fix 7be1f800 (first in 2.2.0-beta214) changed the source-list virtual scroll itemSize to 42.
reproduction: Ensure the Baserow fixture C8oForms E2E -> Regression Fixtures -> Issue 1402 Source Select Labels exists with populated Name and Value columns and 80 controlled rows.
Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Select component and rename it source_select_1402.
Configure the Select as From a data source and select the Baserow table Issue 1402 Source Select Labels through the component source configuration UI.
Choose Name as the display column and Value as the value column.
Open the viewer, open the Select dropdown, scroll to the bottom and observe that the list ends near Choice 80 without a large blank area after it.

1405.title: Hidden data grid recomputes column widths when it becomes visible
1405.rootCause: A Data Grid initialized while hidden by a Visibility condition could compute AG Grid column widths before its container had a usable width. When the condition later made the grid visible, the columns stayed compressed instead of being resized against the actual container width. The ticket was reported around beta212 and manually confirmed OK in beta213.
reproduction: Ensure the Baserow fixture C8oForms E2E -> Regression Fixtures -> Issue 1405 Hidden Grid Width exists with Name, First column, Second column and Third column text fields and controlled rows.
Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Text input and rename it visibility_controller_1405.
Add a Data Grid and rename it hidden_grid_1405.
Configure the Data Grid from the Baserow source Issue 1405 Hidden Grid Width through the component source configuration UI.
Configure the Data Grid Visibility condition so it is shown only when visibility_controller_1405 equals show.
Open the viewer: the grid is initially hidden. Type show in the text input and observe that the visible grid columns use the available width; beta212 leaves them compressed.

1412.title: Map height breaks after opening Data & Interactions
1412.rootCause: The Data & Interactions editor stored config.minHeight without the px unit, producing invalid CSS that collapsed the map to ~44px, in both the editor canvas and the rendered viewer.
reproduction: Log in and open a form that contains a Map component.
Open the map's Configuration -> Données & Interactions tab.
Set the Height field to a value (e.g. 600) and close the panel.
Observe the map in the editor canvas: it collapses to ~44px instead of 600px.
Click Aperçu to open the viewer: the rendered map is collapsed there too.

1413.title: Description breaks when a grid palette path contains a quoted column name
1413.rootCause: viewerPage generated JavaScript literals from grid path segments without escaping quotes or backslashes, so a column name like Owner's name produced invalid JavaScript.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form.
Add a Table component and configure it from the Baserow source C8oForms E2E -> Regression Fixtures -> Issue 1413 Quote DisplayValue.
Set the table's returned value to Ligne sélectionnée.
Add a Description component, drag the table from the palette into the editor, expand the quoted Owner's name column and choose the value leaf exposed by the palette.
Click Aperçu, select the row containing Alice's quoted owner, and observe that beta214 logs SyntaxError: missing ) after argument list instead of rendering cleanly.

1416.title: Baserow date formats and times are preserved in the data grid

alsoCovers.note: Datetime timezone shift: the DateTime EU 24h / US 12h columns and the anti-shift assertions verify that a Baserow datetime without a forced timezone keeps its UTC value instead of being shifted by one hour.

1416.rootCause: Baserow Date fields expose field-level display options (EU, US, ISO, include-time and 12/24h clock) but the C8oForms Data Grid previously rendered date values through the old default yyyy/mm/dd path. The test asserts that the grid consumes the Baserow formatted display values and preserves the expected local time instead of shifting it. Also covers #1424: datetime fields without a forced timezone must keep their Baserow UTC value (lib_BaseRow formssource_GetTableData now reads date_force_timezone and defaults to UTC instead of Europe/Paris).
reproduction: Ensure the Baserow fixture C8oForms E2E -> Regression Fixtures -> Issue 1416 Date Formats exists with Date EU, Date US, Date ISO, DateTime EU 24h and DateTime US 12h columns.
Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Data Grid component and rename it baserow_date_formats_grid_1416.
Configure the Data Grid from the Baserow source Issue 1416 Date Formats through the component source configuration UI.
Open the viewer and observe the row row_1416.
On the broken version, at least one date falls back to yyyy/mm/dd or a datetime shifts away from the Baserow-displayed hour. On the fixed version, EU, US, ISO and datetime formats are preserved.

1419.title: Checkbox equality visibility value disappears after reopening
1419.rootCause: Selecting a single Checkbox as the left side of a Visibility equality condition saved a visibleIf condition whose value was dropped (empty val2.arr), so reopening the editor lost the value. Fixed by b41111b51 (first in beta234). The test asserts on the value surviving a Home -> reopen round-trip, regardless of which editor (chip or text) renders it — not on the editor type, which was a false-failure signal.
reproduction: Create a form with a Checkbox component whose technical id is checkbox1 and whose single value is Oui.
Add a Description component whose technical id is desc1.
Open desc1 configuration, go to Visibility, choose condition-based visibility and add a condition.
Set the left field to checkbox1 and the operator to equals; enter the value Oui.
Return to Home from the editor, then reopen the same application in edit mode from the home card.
Reopen desc1 Visibility and observe that the value Oui is no longer restored.

1421.title: Anonymous legacy form without config should still open
1421.rootCause: The anonymous viewer reads form.config.oneRespByPerson while loading, but some legacy anonymous published documents lack the config object entirely. The fixture is accepted only when the config property itself is absent, not merely when config.oneRespByPerson is missing. On the broken version the missing config throws (Cannot read properties of undefined reading 'oneRespByPerson' in CallViewLiveAndFillFormList) and the legacy anonymous form never renders; the fix (commit b9feb8db7, first in 2.2.0-beta235) wraps the init steps in runNonBlockingInitStep and uses optional chaining (form?.config?.oneRespByPerson).
reproduction: Seed the four CouchDB documents from tests/fixtures/forms/1421 into c8oforms_fs: draft, published, anonymous published (no top-level config), and PWA document.

Seed the two documents a real 'publish anonymous' creates server-side: the anonymous user account in lib_usermanager_fullsync (_id = the anonymous key = the published_anonymous ~c8oAcl; account.hashPassword = sha1Hex(key + '+' + salt); status confirmed) and its group membership in c8ofullsyncgrp (_id = sha256Hex(key + ':_C8O_HIDDEN_' + publishedId), group = _C8O_HIDDEN_<publishedId>, ~c8oAcl = c8o:admin). ensureIssue1421Fixture seeds all of these.

Open the form the way an end user does: its standalone PWA at <DisplayObjects>/pwas/<anonymousKey>/index.html (the engine serves it dynamically from the published doc). The studio /viewer/<id>/<edit>/<i> route is auth-gated and shows 'Unknown user' even for a correct anonymous form, so it must NOT be used.
Observe that the broken version does not tolerate the missing config: the form never renders (config crash around oneRespByPerson), while the fixed version renders the form cleanly.

1422.title: Default value text mode accepts a Source Palette formula without parsing toast
1422.rootCause: Open bug linked to #1109, reported on 2.2.0-beta235 and still reproduced on 2.2.0-beta236. When an Aa/text Default Value receives a Source Palette formula token, the viewer can resolve the formula value but still raises the parsing toast "Unexpected token '??'". The scenario creates the Formula through the component palette and Workflows UI, then drags it from the Source Palette into a Select Default Value text editor.

Double-click Formule from the component palette, open it from Workflows, rename it formula_alpha_1109, and leave it in text mode with value Alpha.
Add a Select component, rename it select_text_formula_1109, and configure local options Alpha, Beta and Gamma.

1412-reopened.title: Map collapses when the height is cleared after being set
1412-reopened.rootCause: Side effect of the first #1412 fix: the viewer appends "px" to the value, so an empty (cleared) height becomes the invalid CSS "px" instead of falling back to the ~400px default.
reproduction: Log in and open a form that contains a Map component.
Open the map's Configuration -> Données & Interactions tab.

Reopen the same tab, clear the Height field (empty value) and close the panel.

Click Aperçu to open the viewer: the rendered map is collapsed there too.

visibility-operators.title: Visibility: every condition operator resolves in the viewer
visibility-operators.rootCause: Non-ticket coverage. Builds, through the Studio UI, a text source (Alpha), a numeric source (5) and a checkbox source (Alpha selected), then one target per operator carrying that condition, and checks the viewer shows/hides it. Covers equals, different, contains, not_contains, greater, greaterequals, minus, minusequals, is_filled, is_empty, among_following, out_following — visible and hidden directions. No form-document writes.

Add one target per operator, each with a Visibility condition referencing the matching source.
Open the viewer and verify each expected-visible target renders and each expected-hidden target is hidden.

visibility-types-a.rootCause: Non-ticket coverage, batch A: text, checkbox, checkbox group, description, select, radio, radio grid, slider, date, time. No form-document writes.

For each batch-A component type, add a target shown by 'inputAlpha equals Alpha' and one hidden by 'inputAlpha equals Nope'.

For each batch-B component type, add a target shown by 'inputAlpha equals Alpha' and one hidden by 'inputAlpha equals Nope'.
Open the viewer and verify exactly the shown instances of each type are visible (hidden ones removed/collapsed).

1404.title: User settings manage MCP tokens without revealing existing token values
1404.rootCause: Before 2.2.0-beta210 the Settings page had no user-managed MCP token section, token creation UI, safe token listing, or revoke action. Commit 37734999 added the Settings UI and APIV2_McpTokenCreate/List/Revoke/Validate sequences; existing token values are listed only as safe metadata.
reproduction: Log in and open the user Settings page.
Find the MCP Tokens section and confirm it displays the instance MCP URL.
Create a named token from the Settings UI.
The newly generated token is displayed once immediately after creation, while a later token-list response contains only safe metadata.
Reload Settings; the token name remains listed but the raw token value is no longer rendered.
Revoke the token from the Settings UI and confirm its status becomes revoked.

1407.title: PWA access can switch from anonymous back to authenticated
1407.rootCause: CreatePwa handled ToggleSwitch modelChanged as a raw string (event == "oui") while ToggleSwitch emits an object with an out value. Choosing authenticated from an anonymous PWA left pwa.notAnonymous false. Fix 2ef5d325 reads event?.out.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Publish the form as a PWA through the editor, configure the required PWA icon by choosing a color, and set access to anonymous.
Open the published app card's PWA editor from the Published applications tab.
Switch access back to authenticated and save.
On beta214 the PWA remains anonymous after saving; on beta216 and later the saved PWA has notAnonymous=true and reopens with authenticated selected.

1423.title: Baserow source picker resolves the current user table, not another user table
1423.rootCause: lib_BaseRow resolveTableId() (js/common.js) caches application~>database~>table name tuples to Baserow ids in a PROJECT-scoped map keyed by the name tuple only. Baserow workspaces are per-user with identical names but different ids, so concurrent users leak table ids across each other and the source picker resolves another user's table (wrong columns) or an empty field list. Fixed in lib_BaseRow 1.1.42-hotfix25 by prefixing the cache key with the authenticated Baserow user (getUserScope). The fix is deployed on test-nocode; this stays kind 'open' (fixedVersion null) until a C8oForms release bundles the fixed lib_BaseRow, then flip to 'regression' with that tag. The spec is cross-user and self-skips unless at least two C8OFORMS_TEST_USERS are configured.
reproduction: Mint an MCP token for two distinct configured test users.

With each user's token, ensure the same-named Baserow table C8oForms E2E -> Regression Fixtures -> Issue 1423 Cross User Cache Probe, each containing a marker column unique to that user (Owner Alpha 1423 / Owner Bravo 1423).
Log in as the first user, create a blank form, add a Data Grid, and select that table through the source configuration UI; the picker must expose the first user's marker column.

Log in as the second user (sequentially, so the shared cache is already populated) and repeat; on the broken version the picker resolves the first user's table and the second user's marker column is missing.

1425.title: Loop action Palette button is fully visible in action configuration
1425.rootCause: The Loop action editor wrapped DefaultValueEditorWithPalette in overflow-hidden containers. The Source Palette rail button is positioned outside the picker panel, so those wrappers clipped the button and left only a small visible slice. Fix 87c2a01a makes the Loop editor wrappers overflow-visible so the Palette button remains fully visible.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Button component and rename it button_1425.
Open the Button workflow from the Workflows panel.
Add the Loop action from the action palette.
Open the Loop action configuration and observe the Palette rail button next to the Source Palette.
On beta237 the Palette button is clipped horizontally by the Loop action editor wrappers; on the fixed version it is fully visible.
